title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 53 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 53)

content.overview: Section 53 defines a foreign award for Chapter II of Part II in the Geneva Convention framework, using the statutory requirements concerning commercial legal relationships, the relevant historical conventions, written arbitration agreement, date of award and reciprocal territory.
